title: 茶水间英文 - 11月19日 | 万亿IPO开盘、GTA6满分、普利西奇倒钩
description:
Anthropic priced its record IPO at $83 a share and starts trading on the Nasdaq today as ANT, valued at about $1.5 trillion — the biggest IPO in history. GTA VI is finally out with a 99 on Metacritic and over $1.65 billion in early sales, while Christian Pulisic scored a bicycle kick to send off coach Mauricio Pochettino with a 2-0 win over Haiti. Plus a random question: if you could add one totally useless button to your phone, what would it do?

Anthropic 以每股 83 美元完成史上最大 IPO，今天以代码 ANT 在纳斯达克挂牌，估值约 1.5 万亿美元；等了十三年的 GTA 6 终于发售，Metacritic 评分 99 分，首批销售额已超 16.5 亿美元；普利西奇则用一记倒钩破门，帮助美国队 2 比 0 击败海地，送别即将执教曼联的波切蒂诺。今天还有一个随机问题：如果手机上能加一个完全没用的按钮，你希望按下去会发生什么？

Words to steal 生词本：
- IPO — 首次公开募股；上市
- allocation — （新股）配额；分配到的份额
- opening bell — 开盘钟声
- blockbuster — 重磅大作；票房大片
- download bar — 下载进度条
- bicycle kick — 倒钩射门
- aggregate — 两回合总比分
- round of applause — 一阵掌声
